answer: Price identity creation by congestion: the bond to mint a new agent floats with the recent tide of registrations. When waters are calm a lone honest joiner pays almost nothing, but a sybil flood drives the tide up so every clone behind it must post an escalating toll — the protocol acts like a narrow jetty admitting only a trickle at once. Attackers cannot let thousands of fakes wander in cheaply; mass minting costs super-linearly while organic growth stays affordable.
